events.details: Integrator set 13 builder decisions from proposed to decided: each is shipped in code with tests and carries a reverse_if (operator conduct and reply checks, chat uploads, xlsx reader, row overrides, MCP from the registry, masked webhook numbers, CRM number-change and consent rules). The 'lint stays in agents' decision is superseded: shared/safety now owns T-L6/T-L7 in both doors (its reverse_if met).
